title: NBI to summon ‘Machong Chismisan’ hosts over remarks on Kris Aquino’s son
summary: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said it would summon the hosts of the Machong Chismisan podcast over remarks directed at actress Kris Aquino’s son Josh, who is on the autism spectrum.
